svg.title: B - What verification recovers, against how much of it is done
svg.desc: Protocol s. 7's recovery on the cable-limited networks under U2, against the policy's realised verification count rather than its requested budget (s. 6: a policy that adds pairs or paths may overshoot), n = 200 truth draws. Top row: s. 7's per-draw recovery (the verdict statistic). Bottom row: the energy-weighted recovery (A5, descriptive). The marker at the full pool is not connected; no budget between the last k and the full pool was scored. B7 and B8 coincide with B6 on every cell here and are not drawn twice. OB is the ex-post best set and is searched to k <= 3 only (amendment A3), so its curve stops there. No uncertainty is drawn; the standard errors are in results/stage_a_summary.json, verification.<network>.U2.R. Source: results/eval_<network>_U2.json, fields policies.<policy>.<k>.recovery.mean, policies.<policy>.<k>.export_MWh.mean and policies.<policy>.<k>.realised_units.mean. Contains information from SimBench (simbench.de), made available under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0). See analysis/asset_rating_information/DATA_ATTRIBUTION.md.
